name: Troll of Gorgoroth
subtitle: Abomination of Sauron
game_text:
<keyword>Besieger</keyword>. <keyword>Fierce</keyword>. To play, spot a <culture>Sauron</culture> Orc.
The twilight cost of Troll of Gorgoroth is -2 for each <culture>Sauron</culture> engine you spot.
<phase>Regroup</phase>: Exert Troll of Gorgoroth to stack your besieger on a site you control.
flavor_text: “...they could endure the Sun, so long as the will of Sauron held sway over them.”
